figures.expectation: 2x3 grid (DSA/CHIME rows x tau600 {0,5,20} ms cols): recovered-truth vs true dDM with error bars, colored by S/N (grey 8, blue 25, red 80), squares=2 components, open=2 ms width, x=unconstrained. EXPECT: points hug zero at S/N>=25 on both geometries with error bars covering the residuals; S/N 8 shows larger bars and some unconstrained; no trend of error vs truth (a diagonal would mean a sign/scale bug in the estimator or injector).

Same layout. EXPECT from smoke evidence: narrow single-component cells near zero; WATCH whether wide (2 ms, open) and 2-component (square) cells scatter -- structure-metric methods should degrade on smooth/wide profiles, and gross outliers at high S/N adjudicate the in-tree implementation question.

Same layout. EXPECT from smoke evidence: CHIME row tight around zero; DSA row suspected biased/scattered (smoke showed +4.2 at S/N 80). The DSA full-band sweep is only ~0.57 ms per DM unit (~3.5 samples at 163.84 us product resolution), so intensity-structure metrics are expected to be intrinsically weak there; distinguish weak-but-honest (large sigma, unconstrained flags) from confidently-wrong (small sigma, large miss).

Owner-review sheet v3 (v1 stacked-PNG incomprehensible; v2 conflated accuracy with error calibration in one FAIL and its unbiased-at-own-resolution criterion let an uninformative estimator pass). 3 estimator rows x 2 instrument cols; color = morphology, grey = S/N 8. Each chip carries TWO orthogonal verdicts: line 1 accuracy vs the science requirement (resolve dDM to <= +-0.5 pc/cm3, unbiased; REQ anchored to the 1 pc/cm3 chime_dm agreement floor) -- green only if met, else 'TOO COARSE'; line 2 sigma calibration factor, explicitly marked correctable. Row label states the uniformity verdict: 'sample-wide primary candidate' only if accurate on BOTH geometries (never per-instrument method choice). EXPECT: arrival_regression row green/candidate; dmphase + dmpower rows fail DSA and are marked not-a-candidate despite green CHIME panels.
